psychological_meaning: Yellow-green is often associated with growth, nature, and harmony. It can evoke feelings of freshness, vitality, and balance, combining the optimism of yellow with the grounding qualities of green. It can also represent envy or sickness in some contexts, but generally provides a sense of calm energy and connection to the natural world.
